title: Penyelamat Kecil Kita (Lebah vs Pestisida) — VOX style

scenes.title: 1 dari 3
scenes.narration: Satu dari tiga suapan makanan kamu, berhutang nyawa pada satu makhluk kecil. Lebah.
scenes.visualPrompt: A cute bee as a paper cutout with white sticker border, centered, flanked by two flower cutouts, aged-cream paper background, a large bold number '1/3' as a flat geometric accent in the accent color upper-right.
scenes.motion: slow 2D push-in on the bee, flower cutouts drift slightly, one halftone dot field shimmers gently

scenes.title: Beat 2
scenes.narration: Untuk faham kenapa, kita kena tengok macam mana lebah kerja. Mereka terbang bunga ke bunga, memindahkan debu yang jadikan buah dan sayur wujud.
scenes.visualPrompt: A bee paper cutout flying between three flower cutouts arranged left-to-right, tiny pollen-dot particles as halftone accents, a soft arrow connecting flowers, cream paper panel.
scenes.motion: bee cutout slides left-to-right and settles on each flower, pollen dots shimmer, slow 2D parallax between bee layer and flower layer

scenes.title: Ancaman: Pestisida
scenes.narration: Tapi kini, ladang moden sembur racun perosak. Awan kimia abu-abu menutup medan. Lebah mula hilang arah.
scenes.visualPrompt: A grey chemical-spray cloud cutout drifting over a field of drooping flower cutouts, the bee cutout tumbling off-balance, washi tape strip reading a warning symbol, palette shifts cooler but cream base remains.
scenes.motion: grey cloud cutout drifts laterally left, flower cutouts wilt slightly (one settling element), slow 2D camera hold

scenes.title: Neonicotinoid
scenes.narration: Racun jenis neonicotinoid rosakkan sistem saraf lebah. Mereka sesat, tak boleh pulang ke sarang, dan koloni mula runtuh.
scenes.visualPrompt: An anatomical bee cutout with a glowing red brain/nervous-system overlay as a flat geometric accent, a small bar-chart cutout showing declining colonies 2015 to 2021, halftone dot shadow, charcoal ink lines.
scenes.motion: slow 2D push-in on the bee brain detail, bar-chart bars grow subtly, one element only

scenes.title: Solusi: Organik
scenes.narration: Tapi ada jalan. Petani boleh beralih ke kaedah organik dan semula jadi yang ramah serangga penyerbuk.
scenes.visualPrompt: A sunrise as a flat geometric circle in warm yellow, a lush organic flower-garden collage with a healthy bee cutout flying, a small leaf stamp seal motif, accent color returns warm, cream paper panel.
scenes.motion: sun circle rises slightly and settles, flower cutouts bloom open one by one, bee cutout drifts gently

scenes.title: Jaga Lebah, Jaga Masa Depan
scenes.narration: Sebab lebah bukan sekadar serangga. Mereka penjaga masa depan makanan kita. Jaga lebah, jaga masa depan.
scenes.visualPrompt: A smiling bee cutout flying toward the viewer holding a small badge cutout reading 'Save The Bees' in bold condensed type, clean cream background, one accent-color triangle, generous margins.
scenes.motion: slow 2D push-in on the bee, badge cutout settles, subtle texture shimmer, flat paper only
